name: Code-Generator-Benchmark-1.0.0
description: Code-Generator-Benchmark-1.0.0 is a suite for evaluating models that generate program source code from natural-language prompts. It measures models' ability to produce correct and runnable code across tasks such as synthesis, completion, repair, and translation between languages. Evaluation emphasizes functional correctness alongside token-level metrics to assess both correctness and code quality.
evaluation_method: pass@k and exact_match (functional correctness / unit tests)
reputation: A community benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest adoption among researchers evaluating code-generation models.
